description: Phase 0 - Runnable infrastructure and central package management. Add docker-compose (postgres:16 one instance / four databases orderingdb,inventorydb,paymentdb,sagadb + rabbitmq:3-management), a Directory.Packages.props that centralizes and PINS every package version (critically MassTransit + MassTransit.RabbitMQ + MassTransit.EntityFrameworkCoreIntegration = 8.5.11, flipping Ordering.Api and Payment.Api down from 9.2.3; EF Core 9.0.8; Npgsql 9.0.4; AspNetCore.OpenApi 9.0.12), strip inline Version= from every csproj, and make connection strings + RabbitMQ host env-overridable. Independent foundation feature; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on it.
steps: Create d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\docker-compose.yml: service 'postgres' (image postgres:16, env POSTGRES_USER=postgres POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres, port 5432, named volume, healthcheck pg_isready, mount ./docker/postgres-init to /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d) and service 'rabbitmq' (image rabbitmq:3-management, ports 5672 and 15672, default guest/guest, healthcheck). Add a top-of-file comment (Arabic) documenting the 'one Postgres instance, four logical databases' choice.
Create d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\docker\postgres-init\10-create-databases.sql that CREATE DATABASE orderingdb, inventorydb, paymentdb, sagadb (owner postgres).

Create d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\Directory.Packages.props with <ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>true</ManagePackageVersionsCentrally> and PackageVersion entries: MassTransit 8.5.11, MassTransit.RabbitMQ 8.5.11, MassTransit.EntityFrameworkCoreIntegration 8.5.11, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore 9.0.8, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools 9.0.8, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design 9.0.8, Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 9.0.4, Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi 9.0.12.

Edit every csproj under d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\src that has PackageReference entries (Ordering.Api, Ordering.Infrastructure, Inventory.Api, Inventory.Infrastructure, Payment.Api, Payment.Infrastructure) to remove the Version= attribute from each PackageReference so versions resolve centrally. This changes Ordering.Api + Payment.Api MassTransit from 9.2.3 to 8.5.11.

Add a 'RabbitMq' section (Host=localhost, Username=guest, Password=guest) to appsettings.json of Ordering.Api, Inventory.Api, Payment.Api, keeping existing ConnectionStrings; rely on ASP.NET env-var binding (ConnectionStrings__X, RabbitMq__Host) for Docker override, no extra code.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up -d (cwd repo root) brings postgres and rabbitmq to healthy; http://localhost:15672 reachable with guest/guest; `docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -lqt` lists orderingdb, inventorydb, paymentdb, sagadb.
dotnet restore OrderProcess.sln succeeds with no NU1008/missing central version errors and no leftover inline PackageReference Version= attributes.
dotnet build d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\OrderProcess.sln completes with 0 errors, with MassTransit resolved at 8.5.11 across all projects.
verification: cd d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess; docker compose up -d; docker compose ps (both healthy); docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -lqt (four DBs present).
dotnet restore d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\OrderProcess.sln then dotnet build d:\Projects\Saga_DDD\OrderProcess\OrderProcess.sln -> 0 errors.
findings:
IMPORTANT PORT REMAP (host-side only; container-internal ports unchanged): a DIFFERENT, active compose project named 'orderprocessing' (at D:\projects\orderprocessing, containers order-saga-postgres/order-saga-rabbitmq, up 6+ days) already holds host ports 5432/5672/15672 and must stay up. Per user decision (Option 2), this repo's docker-compose.yml remaps HOST ports: Postgres 5433->5432, RabbitMQ AMQP 5673->5672, RabbitMQ mgmt 15673->15672. Do NOT stop the other project's containers.

CONSEQUENCES FOR LATER FEATURES:
- Postgres is reachable from the host at localhost:5433 (NOT 5432). RabbitMQ AMQP at localhost:5673, mgmt UI at http://localhost:15673 (guest/guest). The old acceptance-criteria references (5432, 15672) are superseded by 5433 / 15673.
- The three Apis' appsettings.json were updated: ConnectionStrings use Port=5433; RabbitMq:Host is 'localhost:5673'. (RabbitMq:Host carries the port because the MassTransit UsingRabbitMq config is not written yet; later features wiring the bus should honor a host string that may include a port, or split into Host+Port. Current value is the single string 'localhost:5673'.)
- The saga host (src/Saga/OrderProcess.Saga) does NOT exist yet (created in a later feature). When created, its appsettings must use SagaDb connection string with Host=localhost;Port=5433;Database=sagadb and RabbitMq:Host=localhost:5673 to match this remap.
- All env-overridable: ConnectionStrings__<Name>, RabbitMq__Host etc. still work for Docker-internal runs (where services resolve each other at 5432/5672).

DATABASES: all four confirmed present via psql -lqt: orderingdb, inventorydb, paymentdb, sagadb (owner postgres).

PACKAGE VERSIONS (central, Directory.Packages.props): MassTransit + MassTransit.RabbitMQ + MassTransit.EntityFrameworkCoreIntegration = 8.5.11 (flipped Ordering.Api + Payment.Api down from 9.2.3, confirmed building); Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore + .Tools + .Design = 9.0.8; Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL = 9.0.4; Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi = 9.0.12. All six csproj with PackageReferences had inline Version= stripped (grep confirms none remain). Later features add versionless PackageReferences; add any NEW package's version to Directory.Packages.props or restore fails with NU1008.

BUILD: dotnet restore + dotnet build OrderProcess.sln both succeed, 0 errors.

DOCKER GOTCHA: `docker compose exec postgres psql -U postgres -lqt` pages with a (END) pager prompt and can hang a non-interactive shell; append ` -P pager=off` or pipe to cat, or add `-t -A -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database;"` for scripted checks. Compose project name is 'orderprocess' (dir name); container names saga_postgres / saga_rabbitmq. No git commit made (per instructions).
